lines.zh: 我沿着平原走，斑纹在草上晃。
lines.en: I cross the plains and my patches shift over the grass.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在自己的影子上。
lines.en: Every step lands on my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我这条腿是黑的，那条是白的。
lines.en: This leg is black, that one is white.

lines.zh: 草太短了，我一走就扬起土。
lines.en: The grass is short; my walking kicks up dust.

lines.zh: 我走成一条直线，从不绕远。
lines.en: I walk in a straight line and never take the long way.

lines.zh: 村子的围栏外，我慢慢踱过去。
lines.en: I amble past the village fence.

lines.zh: 风吹过平原，我的斑纹像在动。
lines.en: Wind crosses the plains and my patches seem to move.

lines.zh: 我停下来啃两口，再接着走。
lines.en: I stop for two bites, then keep walking.

lines.zh: 远处的山越来越近了。
lines.en: The far hills are getting closer.

lines.zh: 我走路总偏左，改不掉。
lines.en: I always drift left and cannot fix it.

lines.zh: 蹄印一深一浅，你猜得出是我。
lines.en: My prints go deep then shallow; you can tell it is me.

lines.zh: 平原很宽，我走到天黑也走不完。
lines.en: The plains are wide; I cannot cross them by nightfall.

lines.zh: 我数自己身上的斑，数到十几就乱了。
lines.en: I count my patches and lose track past ten.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴赶苍蝇，赶不走。
lines.en: I flick my tail at flies and they stay.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得我的黑斑发烫。
lines.en: The sun makes my black patches hot.

lines.zh: 我嚼草的时候，眼睛还看着远处。
lines.en: While I chew, my eyes stay on the distance.

lines.zh: 这头牛的斑比我大，我不服。
lines.en: That cow has bigger patches; I object.

lines.zh: 我低头喝水，看见水里也有斑。
lines.en: I drink and see patches in the water too.

lines.zh: 草的味道一般，我也吃。
lines.en: The grass tastes plain, but I eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，斑纹压在土上。
lines.en: I lie down and my patches press into the dirt.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我背上，站了一会儿。
lines.en: A bird lands on my back and stays a while.

lines.zh: 我的角短，打架不占便宜。
lines.en: My horns are short, no advantage in a fight.

lines.zh: 风里有蜂蜜味，是从村子那边来的。
lines.en: There is honey on the wind, from the village side.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，下巴快碰到地。
lines.en: I yawn and my chin nearly touches the ground.

lines.zh: 这条尾巴一天到晚在忙。
lines.en: This tail is busy all day long.

lines.zh: 天快下雨了，我的斑纹先暗下来。
lines.en: Rain is coming; my patches darken first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼，嚼到没味才咽。
lines.en: I chew slowly and swallow when the taste is gone.

lines.zh: 有只苍蝇落在我眼角，我眨一下。
lines.en: A fly lands by my eye, so I blink.

lines.zh: 我抬头看云，云走得比我快。
lines.en: I look up at the clouds; they move faster than me.

lines.zh: 我的斑在树荫下看不清了。
lines.en: In the shade my patches blur together.

lines.zh: 你看我做什么，我身上有花？
lines.en: Why stare? Do I have flowers on me?

lines.zh: 我不是哞花，别拿碗过来。
lines.en: I am no Moobloom; do not bring that bowl.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西是皮革吗？
lines.en: Is that leather in your hand?

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，上次踩过我。
lines.en: I know those boots; they stepped on me.

lines.zh: 你摸吧，我这身斑不怕摸。
lines.en: Go on, touch them; my patches can take it.

lines.zh: 你看着像要数我的斑。
lines.en: You look like you are about to count my patches.

lines.zh: 我脸上一块黑一块白，别笑。
lines.en: My face is black and white in blocks; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 你想骑我？我背不平。
lines.en: Want to ride me? My back is uneven.

lines.zh: 你站那边，风把你的味道吹过来了。
lines.en: Stand there; the wind brings your scent over.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你才回头。
lines.en: I have watched you a long time; only now you turn.

lines.zh: 你的手很凉。
lines.en: Your hands are cold.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，人怕我这身花纹。
lines.en: I am not afraid of people; they fear my markings.

lines.zh: 打得我整块斑都在跳。
lines.en: The blow makes a whole patch of me jump.

lines.zh: 你砍在我肋骨上。
lines.en: You cut across my ribs.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，往前冲了两步。
lines.en: I grunt once and lurch two steps forward.

lines.zh: 皮破了，底下还是皮。
lines.en: The hide splits; there is hide beneath.

lines.zh: 这一下够我记你很久。
lines.en: I will remember you for that one.

lines.zh: 我血滴在草上，很显眼。
lines.en: My blood on the grass stands out.

lines.zh: 我前膝磕在地上，硬撑着。
lines.en: My foreknee hits the ground and I brace.

lines.zh: 疼得我把头甩来甩去。
lines.en: The pain makes me swing my head around.

lines.zh: 我退进牛群里。
lines.en: I retreat into the herd.

lines.zh: 你出手真重。
lines.en: You really hit hard.

lines.zh: 小麦是吧，我闻到了。
lines.en: Wheat, is it? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你举过头顶，我脖子短。
lines.en: You hold it overhead; my neck is short.

lines.zh: 我只为吃的跟你走。
lines.en: I follow you only for the food.

lines.zh: 别用草骗我，我要麦子。
lines.en: Do not fool me with grass; I want wheat.

lines.zh: 你的手心有盐味。
lines.en: There is salt on your palm.

lines.zh: 我小跑两步，斑纹都糊了。
lines.en: I trot two steps and my patches blur.

lines.zh: 这一把够不够换我一段路？
lines.en: Is this handful enough for a stretch of my company?

lines.zh: 我跟着你，别走太快。
lines.en: I am coming; do not walk so fast.

lines.zh: 掉地上的那颗，我捡了。
lines.en: That grain on the ground, I am taking it.

lines.zh: 你口袋里还有吧？我都听见了。
lines.en: There is more in your pocket, is there not? I heard it.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我也撞回去。
lines.en: You bump me, I bump back.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，是你走过来。
lines.en: I was standing still; you walked into me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的斑都挤歪了。
lines.en: That shove squashed my patches crooked.

lines.zh: 让开点，我这身骨头很重。
lines.en: Move aside; these bones are heavy.

lines.zh: 你踩我蹄子，我没踩你。
lines.en: You stepped on my hoof; I did not step on yours.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你，别再挤。
lines.en: I turn sideways for you; stop pushing.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草都压平了。
lines.en: We collide and the grass flattens under us.

lines.zh: 角碰到角，声音很闷。
lines.en: Horn meets horn with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我往后退，你却往前。
lines.en: I back up; you come forward.

lines.zh: 好了好了，各走一边。
lines.en: All right, all right; each to his own side.

lines.zh: 你的斑比我整齐。
lines.en: Your patches are neater than mine.

lines.zh: 我闻闻你，别躲。
lines.en: Let me smell you; do not shy away.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在你脖子上。
lines.en: I rest my head against your neck.

lines.zh: 两头花斑牛站在一起，像块布。
lines.en: Two pinto cows together look like one cloth.

lines.zh: 我们的斑会凑出什么花样？
lines.en: What pattern will our patches make together?

lines.zh: 你吃这边，我吃那边。
lines.en: You eat here; I will eat over there.

lines.zh: 别急，草不会跑。
lines.en: Easy; the grass is not going anywhere.

lines.zh: 我在你身边转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once around you.

lines.zh: 你的角比我的长一点。
lines.en: Your horns are a little longer than mine.

lines.zh: 等小牛落地，它的斑会更花。
lines.en: When the calf drops, its patches will be even wilder.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起来了。
lines.en: I curled it up with my tongue.

lines.zh: 这东西比草硬。
lines.en: This is harder than grass.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，走了一路。
lines.en: I carried it in my teeth a long way.

lines.zh: 它掉进我的蹄印里了。
lines.en: It fell into one of my hoofprints.

lines.zh: 我推给你，你自己拿。
lines.en: I push it to you; you take it.

lines.zh: 皮革的味道，我认得。
lines.en: The smell of leather, I know it.

lines.zh: 我咬太紧，它瘪了。
lines.en: I bit too hard and it dented.

lines.zh: 别放我背上，会滑下去。
lines.en: Not on my back; it will slide off.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到墙边。
lines.en: I nudge it against the wall.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿比我还倔。
lines.en: This thing is more stubborn than I am.

lines.zh: 你刚才是想剥我的皮？
lines.en: Were you just about to skin me?

lines.zh: 这块草场是我先来的。
lines.en: I was on this pasture first.

lines.zh: 你打在我白斑上，那块发烫。
lines.en: You struck my white patch and it burns.

lines.zh: 我把短角压低，冲你来了。
lines.en: I dip my short horns and come at you.

lines.zh: 平原上没地方躲，你最好跑。
lines.en: There is nowhere to hide on the plains; you had better run.

lines.zh: 你的刀别往我这边靠。
lines.en: Keep that blade away from me.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑不是给你做衣服的。
lines.en: My patches are not cloth for you.

lines.zh: 我看见你数过我的牛了。
lines.en: I saw you counting my herd.

lines.zh: 这次我不退。
lines.en: This time I am not backing off.

lines.zh: 你要牛肉，就自己来拿。
lines.en: You want beef? Come and take it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，平原上看得远。
lines.en: I watch you; the plains give a long view.

lines.zh: 你绕到左边，我横过去挡。
lines.en: You go around left; I cut across to block.

lines.zh: 我不快不慢，踏着你的脚印。
lines.en: Neither fast nor slow, I step in your prints.

lines.zh: 我的蹄声在空地上很响。
lines.en: My hooves sound loud on open ground.

lines.zh: 你跑不过四条腿。
lines.en: You cannot outrun four legs.

lines.zh: 我挡在村口，你出不去。
lines.en: I block the village gate; you cannot leave.

lines.zh: 风吹来你的味道，跑不掉。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我前蹄刨土，头已经低了。
lines.en: I paw the dirt with my head already down.

lines.zh: 你回头看了一眼，怕了吧。
lines.en: You glanced back once; scared, are you not?

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩十步。
lines.en: Only ten steps remain between us.

lines.zh: 角顶在你腰上，你弯了下去。
lines.en: My horn catches your side and you fold over.

lines.zh: 我撞得很实，自己蹄子都滑了。
lines.en: I hit solid and my own hooves slide.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了那块草场。
lines.en: That one was for the pasture.

lines.zh: 我的头沉，撞起来不轻。
lines.en: My head is heavy; it hits hard.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我又顶上去。
lines.en: You stagger back and I push again.

lines.zh: 斑纹上溅了土，我不管。
lines.en: Dirt splashes my patches; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你推开。
lines.en: I swing my head and shove you off.

lines.zh: 你还站得住吗？
lines.en: Are you still standing?

lines.zh: 我喘着气，鼻孔里全是土。
lines.en: I pant, dust in both nostrils.

lines.zh: 别装死，起来。
lines.en: Do not play dead; get up.

lines.zh: 我站在平原中央，风把草压低。
lines.en: I stand mid-plain while the wind flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 这片草地今天多了一头花斑牛。
lines.en: The meadow has one more pinto cow today.

lines.zh: 我出生的时候，天很亮。
lines.en: The sky was bright when I was born.

lines.zh: 我站起来，四条腿都在打抖。
lines.en: I stand and all four legs tremble.

lines.zh: 母牛舔掉我身上的湿毛。
lines.en: The mother cow licks the wet from my coat.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑还没长开。
lines.en: My patches have not spread out yet.

lines.zh: 第一次看见平原，我以为它没有边。
lines.en: The first time I saw the plains, I thought they had no edge.

lines.zh: 我学着别的牛，低头吃草。
lines.en: I copy the other cows and lower my head to graze.

lines.zh: 村子在很远的东边。
lines.en: The village is far to the east.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，没人理。
lines.en: Nobody answered my first call.

lines.zh: 草叶比我还高。
lines.en: The grass is taller than I am.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，我跟着牛群走。
lines.en: The sun sets and I follow the herd.

lines.zh: 火苗窜上背，黑斑先焦了。
lines.en: Flame climbs my back and the black patches char first.

lines.zh: 我从土坡滚下，摔得斑都乱了。
lines.en: I roll down the bank and land with my patches in a mess.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我在泥里乱蹬。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I kick wildly in the mud.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我抛起，斑纹翻了个面。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and my patches roll over.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我肩，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I lurch with each step.

lines.zh: 药水泼上来，我的白斑变绿了。
lines.en: Potion splashes me and my white patches turn green.

lines.zh: 草场被啃光了，我肋骨全露出来。
lines.en: The pasture is grazed bare and my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，麻到蹄子。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horn and the numbness reaches my hooves.

lines.zh: 我掉出平原，风也停了。
lines.en: I fall out of the plains and the wind stops.
